title: Mamdani says feds have abdicated on AI, urges New Yorkers to push back
text: Mayor Zohran Mamdani said Monday night that New Yorkers must resist the narrative that an AI takeover is inevitable and demand regulations that protect the public and put power back in their hands.

title: Nscale and Anthropic are reportedly in talks for yet another $45B compute deal
text: If the deal goes through, it would be the latest in a long string of giant compute deals Anthropic has struck over the past year.

title: Microsoft says AI agents are like insider threats as ‘frontier models can’t be trusted’
text: Microsoft wants enterprises to closely watch the agents that employees use with systems not controlled by AI labs like OpenAI and Anthropic.

title: Amazon is taking its biggest shot at Nvidia yet with new TorchNeuron dev tool
text: Amazon wants to break Nvidia’s hold on PyTorch, the free toolkit used to build most AI apps, so that more developers run their apps on alternative chips like its own.

title: Tolan snags $30M for its AI companion that helps users navigate life
text: AI companion app Tolan has raised another $30 million after attracting more than 250,000 active users.

title: Replika’s founder built the AI assistant she pitched at Disrupt 12 years ago
text: Eugenia Kuyda's newest startup Wabi is positioned to take advantage of an idea she had more than a decade ago. Wabi offers a personal AI assistant with a twist, free and downloadable to anyone today.

title: Tenstorrent hits $6.2B valuation to scale open-weight AI chips
text: After drawing acquisition interest earlier this year, the Nvidia challenger raised $1.5 billion to remain independent.

title: People are using AI to make their smart TVs dumb again
text: Fed up with ads, tracking, and sluggish interfaces, some smart TV owners are turning to AI agents to strip away bloatware and take back control of their TVs.

title: Nvidia launches new open models to run agents in the enterprise and on PCs
text: Nvidia is leaning hard into the trend of enterprise companies wanting to run their own open models in their own data centers and also trying to make on-device, private AI agents a thing.
